submission.question: ordered text parts joined with newline
submission.context_id: server-generated or a context already bound to this caller/project/session
submission.task_id: must be absent; follow-up submission creates another owner-reviewed run
submission.owner_approval: always required; submission does not execute research

configuration.return_immediately: supported; owner review is always returned immediately

authorization.task_context_artifact_isolation: caller binding is required even with grants to the same project
authorization.result_metadata: result:read; project:read alone grants no artifact metadata or bytes

durability.storage: PostgreSQL a2a_contexts, a2a_tasks, a2a_messages and the domain run ledger
durability.transaction: submission and all transport mappings commit atomically
durability.replay: same caller/message ID and content fingerprint returns the existing run across restart
durability.changed_payload: safe protocol conflict; never creates another run

subscriptions.updates: new snapshot when revision or event cursor changes
subscriptions.terminal_tasks: current terminal snapshot then stream closes; GetTask remains available
subscriptions.reconnect: fresh snapshot; no promise of full history

artifacts.authentication: bearer plus task caller binding and result:read
artifacts.reference: SDK Artifact with Part.url, declared mediaType and size/hash/partial metadata
artifacts.verification: entire recorded size and SHA-256 checked before response headers or bytes
artifacts.revocation: recheck before every 64 KiB chunk; stop delivery on denial; declared length detects truncation

deployment.base_url: operator supplies the actual advertised origin
deployment.listeners: loopback by default; LAN requires explicit TLS and restricted host/origin configuration in the containing application
deployment.stop_callback: parent injects supervisor-backed on_stop(db, run_id); absent callback rejects active cancellation

acceptance_scope: synthetic real-SDK loopback HTTP/SSE plus dedicated PostgreSQL; outbound peers and deployment live gates remain separate
